description: 0.3.0 target architecture. Map 0 accepted by the owner; submaps and detailed contracts are provisional. Arrows are calls including their declared response, except explicitly named guidance/data/event arrows. No transitive access. Only 5 exposes shared part state; each other component may exclusively own private state. No source compliance has been established. Extension resource access added by owner request: Thingi10K belongs in Extensions, with an explicit external-resource wire. Extensions are unsandboxed local code; contracts describe intended SAAM/reviewed-extension structure, not confinement of arbitrary scripts. Owner confirmed preservation of a simplified Studio–agent channel, priority event batches and exclusive per-bundle editing; saved artifacts remain inspectable without regeneration dependencies.

contracts.label: resource request
contracts.direction: Caller → provider; declared response included.
contracts.inputs: Source identity and query or asset identity.
contracts.outputs: Search results or acquired asset bytes, digest, provenance and license metadata.
contracts.effects: Explicit resource IO; no bundle mutation.
contracts.failure: Return unavailable, denied, invalid response or cancellation; never substitute another asset silently.
contracts.excludes: Reviewed extensions keep IO explicit; this convention does not technically restrict arbitrary local scripts.

contracts.label: search / download
contracts.direction: Extensions → external resource provider; response included.
contracts.inputs: Explicit provider request; credentials remain privately owned.
contracts.outputs: Results, resource bytes and available provenance/license metadata.
contracts.effects: Declared network/local-source reads; owned temporary/cache storage.
contracts.failure: Report network/provider/permission failures; validate acquired content before use.
contracts.excludes: No uploads or remote code execution are included in this proposed retrieval contract; arbitrary local scripts are not sandboxed.

contracts.label: run extension
contracts.direction: Caller → provider; declared response included.
contracts.inputs: Selected extension identity, parameters, explicit inputs and documented resource use.
contracts.outputs: Geometry/construction values or acquired assets plus provenance, for an explicit bundle edit.
contracts.effects: Extension-private computation and declared resource IO only.
contracts.failure: Return structured errors or cancellation without changing the active bundle.
contracts.excludes: No confirmation, direct bundle mutation or private engine access.

contracts.label: requests / event batches
contracts.inputs: Owner/instance/bundle identity, request identity and ordered batch: an alert plus accumulated held observations.
contracts.outputs: Agent acknowledgement, progress/result or waiting/failure response for the matching request.
contracts.effects: Channel-private queue/request state; edits still use the bundle interface.
contracts.failure: Expose disconnected/failed work without inventing agent progress; explicit reads can recover pending requests.
contracts.excludes: No cross-agent ownership or direct mutation of Studio internals; diagnostic emission is a separate service interface.
contracts.direction: Studio → owning agent: requests and alert-level event batches; subscription setup and correlated responses are included.

contracts.label: request / tour event
contracts.inputs: User request or tour event, scoped to the owning Studio instance and bundle.
contracts.effects: Studio-private coordination only.
contracts.failure: Show pending/disconnected status; preserve request identity.
contracts.excludes: No recipe mutation through event payloads.
contracts.direction: Caller → provider; declared response included.

contracts.label: observe changes
contracts.inputs: Revisioned observations, displayed result, build failure/cancellation or other classified event.
contracts.effects: Studio-private queue state only.
contracts.failure: Ignore stale identities; do not claim unseen output was displayed.
contracts.excludes: Held observations alone do not trigger a live alert.
contracts.direction: Caller → provider; declared response included.
